claude连接第三方模型开启自动模式，想让他干一晚上，我好睡觉。早上起来总是看到卡在分类器

Error: claude-sonnet-4-6 is temporarily unavailable, so auto mode cannot determine the safety of Monitor right now. Wait a moment and then try this action again. If it keeps failing, continue with other tasks that don’t require this action and come back to it later. Note: reading files, searching code, and other read-only operations do not require the classifier and can still be used.

老生常谈了, 如果自己几乎不审查代码, 可以直接放开权限让ai干 "permissions": { "defaultMode": "bypassPermissions" },
